reading: The sketch is a Kanban/task board: a top filter bar, four column-header lines (To do/In progress/Review/Done with counts), two swimlane dividers ("WEB APP" and "MOBILE") each followed by a row of task cards with tags, titles, progress bars and round avatar dots, some cards faded/struck-through as done.
